items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: He did have Freddie Keppel with him. With him and his band.

ctx.x: Oh, your father didn't teach you then? No, my father didn't teach me. John taught me. Do you remember any other bands that your father ever told that he played in?

Well, Bill, he did tell me many bands he played in. Tell the truth, I don't know whether it was Emmanuel Perez or Joe Oliver. I know he played with Freddie Keppel. He did, he was a man. He did have Freddie Keppel with him. With him and his band. Yeah, his band, yes. And he had another trumpet player. We used to call him a cornet player. That was named Nene Kwaku. Oh, yeah. That was a trumpet player. I heard it. But one time.
Did anyone else in your family, that is, were there any uncles, the older members, your mother play anything or did she sing?
